purpose: Remove label influence from the character pseudo-label case rule (user request).
replaces: v1 a-priori case-ambiguous list CKOPSUVWXZ and the case-folding choice informed by real-label diagnostics
held_out_synthetic: Each member scored on the OTHER synthetic corpus it never trained on: M1A, M2A, M3A on cryptbb_v3/B; M1B, M2B on cryptbb_v3/A. 10000 images per corpus, fixed seed 20261115, uniform sample of LMDB indices.
case_swap_rate: For each letter pair (e.g. s/S): among held-out positions whose true char is in the pair and whose length-5 prediction at that position is in the pair, fraction predicted in the wrong case. Pooled over all 5 members.
rule: A letter pair is case-ambiguous iff case_swap_rate >= 0.02 with >= 200 pooled occurrences. Fixed now; not revised after seeing results.

char_modes.exact: all 5 identical and letter pair not case-ambiguous (digits always exact-eligible)
char_modes.case_insensitive: all 5 identical ignoring case AND (pair is case-ambiguous OR members disagree on case)

note_on_committee_case_disagreement: Positions where members agree on the letter but split on case are treated case_insensitive because the committee itself is uncertain; this is a label-free signal.
real_labels: Not read by any step. No real-label accuracy check of v2 will be run by Claude unless the user explicitly asks.
